comment: Refreshes every control from the selected light

comment: Calls the startup entry of every registered LECMODULE; on failure unwinds and reports 'LecShare Startup: Failed with module'

comment: Zeroes the 0x605-dword registry and stores the application name and version

comment: Entries are 3 dwords: name, vtable, reference count

comment: Looks a module up by name (wildcards allowed), honouring the application's override list

comment: Drops one reference from the entry owning the given vtable

comment: Resolves a null-terminated list of {out, name} subscriptions
